name: @darkfactory/root
description: A modular, Postgres-first, AI-native application foundation.

scripts.dev: bun scripts/dev-bindings.ts && portless darkfactory bun scripts/dev.ts web
scripts.operator:dev: bun scripts/dev-bindings.ts operator && portless operator.darkfactory bun scripts/dev.ts operator
scripts.typecheck: bunx --no-install turbo run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: bunx --bun --no-install biome lint . && bun run lint:markdown && bun run lint:knip
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract && bun run test:operations && bun run test:integration && bun run verify:browser
scripts.test:unit: bunx --no-install turbo run test:unit --concurrency=50% -- --maxWorkers=1 && bun run test:unit:root
scripts.test:unit:root: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project unit tests/generator playwright.config.test.ts
scripts.test:contract: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project contract
scripts.test:operations: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project operations --project e2e-helpers
scripts.test:integration: bun scripts/with-test-env.ts pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project integration
scripts.test:e2e: bun scripts/with-test-env.ts pnpm exec playwright test --project e2e
scripts.test:a11y: bun scripts/with-test-env.ts pnpm exec playwright test --project a11y
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.verify:core: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run auth:schema:check && bun run openapi:check && bun run typecheck && bun run docs:check
scripts.verify:coverage: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project unit --project contract --project operations --project e2e-helpers --coverage
scripts.verify:prepush: bun run verify:core && bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract && bun run test:operations
scripts.verify:browser: bun run build && bun scripts/with-test-env.ts pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.verify: bun run verify:core && bun run verify:coverage && bun run verify:integration && bun run verify:browser
scripts.deploy:web: bun run deploy:web:validate && pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy
scripts.deploy:web:check: bun run deploy:web:validate && pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:web:preview: bun run deploy:web:validate && pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --preview
scripts.deploy:web:staging: bun run deploy:web:validate && pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:web:staging:check: bun run deploy:web:validate && pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --dry-run --env staging
